```bash
# Fetch IBM stock price
ibm_price=$(curl -s "https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/IBM.N?interval=1d" | jq -r '.chart.result[0].meta.regularMarketPrice')

# Calculate total cost for 12 shares
total_usd=$((12 * $ibm_price))

# Convert USD to EUR
exchange_rate=$(curl -s "https://api.openexchangerates.org/latest?base=USD" | jq -r '.rates.EUR')
total_eur=$(echo "$total_usd * $exchange_rate" | bc)

# Send email
echo "$total_eur EUR" | sendEmail -f sender@example.com -t finance@example.com -s smtp.example.com:587 -xu sender@example.com -xp password -u 'Quote IBM' -m "The cost of 12 IBM shares in EUR is €$total_eur."
```
